chars.F: FARID: a young Moroccan man wearing a light blue button-up shirt with rolled sleeves, a loosened navy tie, dark grey trousers.
chars.M: MERYEM: an elegant woman in her forties wearing a fitted burgundy blazer over a black blouse, a black pencil skirt, red high heels and big gold hoop earrings.

scenes.name: n1.png
scenes.scene: FARID sits at his desk with his laptop, looking up surprised and wide-eyed; MERYEM stands right in front of his desk with a cheeky smile, holding a dark bottle in one hand and two glasses in the other. Comic awkward moment. Setting: a modern open-plan office in Casablanca at night, empty desks, only a desk lamp lit, city lights through a big window.

scenes.name: n2.png
scenes.scene: MERYEM leans on FARID's desk offering him a glass with a playful smile; FARID politely refuses with one raised hand, pointing at his laptop screen, sweating a little. Setting: a modern open-plan office in Casablanca at night, empty desks, only a desk lamp lit, city lights through a big window.

scenes.name: n3.png
scenes.scene: MERYEM holds up her hand showing five fingers with a persuasive smile; FARID gives in, shrugging with an awkward smile. Setting: a modern open-plan office in Casablanca at night, empty desks, only a desk lamp lit, city lights through a big window.

scenes.name: n4.png
scenes.scene: MERYEM rolls an office chair right next to FARID and sits very close beside him; FARID looks sideways at her, nervous, stiff on his chair. Setting: a modern open-plan office in Casablanca at night, empty desks, only a desk lamp lit, city lights through a big window.

scenes.name: n5.png
scenes.scene: MERYEM talks with expressive hand gestures, telling a story, sitting next to FARID at the desk; FARID nods politely while holding papers. Setting: a modern open-plan office in Casablanca at night, empty desks, only a desk lamp lit, city lights through a big window.

scenes.name: n6.png
scenes.scene: Close shot of both at the desk: MERYEM chatting and smiling, FARID staring at her face dreamily, completely distracted, papers slipping from his hands. Setting: a modern open-plan office in Casablanca at night, empty desks, only a desk lamp lit, city lights through a big window.

scenes.name: n7.png
scenes.scene: FARID and MERYEM sitting face to face very close in the lamp light, looking into each other's eyes, FARID talking shyly with his hand on his chest. Setting: a modern open-plan office in Casablanca at night, empty desks, only a desk lamp lit, city lights through a big window.

scenes.name: n8.png
scenes.scene: MERYEM leans closer and places her hand on FARID's knee; FARID freezes in shock, eyes huge, arms stiff in the air. Comic embarrassed moment. Setting: a modern open-plan office in Casablanca at night, empty desks, only a desk lamp lit, city lights through a big window.

scenes.name: n9.png
scenes.scene: MERYEM leans in very close to FARID's face with half-closed eyes; FARID is frozen on his chair, leaning back slightly, sweating, shocked expression. Setting: a modern open-plan office in Casablanca at night, empty desks, only a desk lamp lit, city lights through a big window.
